summary: S-1 meets C-1 to C-5. The diff touches only src/notes.mjs and tests/notes.test.mjs, both in the slice paths. listNotes filters (which makes a new array) and then sorts newest first, and it matches tags case-insensitively. No tests were weakened, and I found no credentials or non-English text. npm test: 5 pass, 0 fail. The slice has no UI, so no browser check was needed.

findings.issue: The sort uses localeCompare on ISO timestamps. This depends on the locale, though it gives the right order for the ISO format createNote writes.
findings.suggestion: Optional: use a plain string comparison.

criteria.note: createNote is unchanged and rejects a blank title. The existing test covers it.
The new test checks id, title, body, tags and createdAt.
Sorted by createdAt descending, with an id tie-break.
filter always returns a new array, so the store is never returned or reordered.
Both sides are lowercased. The test covers mixed-case tags and a non-matching tag.

browser.note: Non-UI slice; no browser verification required.
